title: The Purple flower by the wall
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：purple　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 purple 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the musician wrote of ① a purple flower by the wall in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② so purple that nobody in the hall would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the purple ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the purple flower by the wall that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1952 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too purple to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the purple ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a purple prose of the writer, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as purple as the prose of the writer they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was purple or not, and he said so.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something purple, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite purple; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the purple ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968, at once, she wrote of another purple flower by the wall in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less purple than anybody had expected. ⑩ The purple prose of the writer that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1970, was the one she could never quite name; the purple ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 紫色（前置定语 a purple flower by the wall：1958 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件紫色的花）
B. adj. 紫色／华丽（两处加强说法：so purple that … 与 no less purple than …）
C. adj. 紫色／华丽（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 紫色（表语 too purple to do：母亲觉得它太紫色，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 华丽（前置定语 a purple prose of the writer：叔叔把整件事称作一桩华丽的散文）
F. adj. 华丽（同级比较 as purple as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩作家华丽的散文相比）
G. adj. 华丽（后置定语 something purple：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 华丽（受程度副词修饰 quite purple：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a purple flower by the wall
the purple flower by the wall that
a purple prose of the writer
The purple prose of the writer that

answers.why: purple 意为“紫色”，1958 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件紫色的花”，此处作前置定语 a purple flower by the wall。
purple 意为“紫色”，此处用 so purple that 结构，说它紫色到音乐厅里没人敢靠近。
purple 意为“紫色”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的紫色墙边紫色的花，等于最高级的说法。
purple 意为“紫色”，母亲认为这件东西“太紫色了，谁也用不上”，too purple to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
purple 意为“华丽”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩华丽的散文”，此处作前置定语 a purple prose of the writer。
purple 意为“华丽”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩作家华丽的散文一样华丽”，同级比较用 as purple as。
purple 意为“华丽”，节目单上那半行字要的是“华丽的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something purple。
purple 意为“华丽”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当华丽”，quite 修饰原级 purple。
purple 意为“华丽”，no less purple than 表示“其华丽不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之华丽不亚于任何人的预料。
purple 意为“华丽”，母亲 1970 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的华丽散文”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件紫色的花。（a purple flower by the wall）
它紫色到音乐厅里没有一个人敢靠近。（so purple that …）
母亲觉得它太紫色，谁也用不上。（too purple to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩华丽的散文。（a purple prose of the writer）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩作家华丽的散文一样华丽。（as purple as …）
到了 1965 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件华丽的东西。（something purple）
answers: In 1958 the musician wrote of a purple flower by the wall in the programme.
It was so purple that nobody in the hall would go near it.
My mother thought it too purple to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a purple prose of the writer.
He said nobody would call it as purple as the prose of the writer they had once had.
By 1965 the programme asked for nothing but something purple.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 purple 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the musician wrote of a purple flower by the wall in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the purple flower by the wall that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too purple to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a purple prose of the writer, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite purple, and everybody laughed.
The purple ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
